title: Evaluating the Effect of Mucinex 1200mg on Mucociliary and Cough Clearance During an Acute Respiratory Infection
brief_summary: The purpose of this research study is to explore the mechanism of action of Mucinex, an oral, over-the-counter, FDA approved expectorant in patients with acute respiratory tract infections.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Symptoms of cough, thickened mucus and chest congestion
* Able to produce sputum
* Non Smoker

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Smokers
* Fever above 101°F
* Any chronic illness
